models.mechanism: Ahad now defines a uniquely asymmetric position in a dependency network. Through al-samad, needs converge toward the one relied-on endpoint; through the paired birth negations, no genealogical arrow either leaves that endpoint toward offspring or enters it from a parent. The focus's oneness is thus read as singular independence amid one-way resort, not merely as having a numerical value of one.

structural_cues: Lam is repeated with the same root in active yalid and passive yulad, reversing the node's role while preserving negation.
The birth reversal follows the one-center/reliance pair Allah-ahad / Allah-al-samad.
The active-passive symmetry closes both genealogical directions around the same implicit subject.

abductive_moves.assumption: Birth relations constitute dependency arrows, so denying both directions sets the relied-on endpoint outside the genealogical network that connects and derives ordinary members.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies resort toward al-samad and symmetrical negation of begetting and being born, but it does not explicitly equate birth with dependency or link that network to ahad.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: Packet supplies need-bearers -> samad and negates subject -> offspring plus parent -> subject; I infer that the remaining topology is one-way reliance upon an underived, non-propagating center.
alternatives: The birth negations may rebut two discrete claims without defining a network structure.
Ahad may remain absolute oneness independently of reliance and lineage.

changed_reading.before: At stage 1, ahad was the single convergence point at which many acts of resort terminate.
changed_reading.after: Ahad is now the sole convergence point that does not itself enter the reciprocal chain of derivation: approached by dependents, yet neither downstream from a parent nor upstream through offspring.

minimal_triggers: repeated lam plus active/passive reversal in 112:3
models.ablation: Removing 112:3 returns the model to generic convergence; removing the active/passive reversal leaves only one genealogical direction closed and destroys the fully asymmetric topology.

models.mechanism: The non-hollow, sealed center from stage 1 acquires explicit boundary behavior: nothing is generated outward from it and it is not generated inward from another source. The two negated birth directions act like denied output and input across an intact boundary; compactness prevents internal partition, sealing prevents passage, and endurance preserves the undivided center through time.

supplies an interior without cavity or separable generative space
models a boundary closed against passage
the event denied in both outward-active and inward-passive orientations
specifies the denied production of a derivative and denied derivation from an origin

structural_cues: Yalid and yulad repeat one root under two lam negations while switching active to passive voice.
The double negation immediately follows al-samad, bringing birth events into proximity with solidity, sealing, and endurance branches.
Ahad precedes the compact/sealed image, so denied input and output preserve the focus predicate's undividedness.

abductive_moves.assumption: Begetting and being born can be mapped as output and input through a boundary, and their negation explains how a compact center remains undivided.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies birth reversal and the separate ṣamad images of non-hollowness and sealing; the spatial boundary mapping is imaginative synthesis rather than stated grammar.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: Packet denies outward birth and inward derivation and supplies compact/sealed images; I infer closed boundary -> no division or transfer -> preserved ahad integrity.
alternatives: Birth may be solely genealogical, making the input/output material mapping too literal.
Ṣamad's resort branch may be primary and its solidity/sealing branches inactive.

changed_reading.before: At stage 1, ahad could evoke a non-porous center whose solidity and endurance made it dependable.
changed_reading.after: The paired birth negations specify what the intact boundary excludes: neither a derivative exits nor an originating process enters, so ahad becomes indivisibility maintained against both generative directions.

models.ablation: Removing 112:3 leaves the stage-1 solidity image without explicit boundary behavior; removing either yalid or yulad makes the closure one-sided, and removing ṣamad B002/B003 collapses the material mechanism into generic lineage denial.

surprise_reading: The new double negation turns 'One' into a topology of independence: every need may point toward the relied-on center, but no birth-arrow points into or out of it. Materially, the center is imagined as so compact and sealed that neither derivation nor division crosses its boundary.
discarded_or_unchanged: The attribution-control model receives general support from explicit negation but no comparably distinctive structural revision, so it remains omitted under the two-model cap.
